newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish stocks move upwards with thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Turkish stocks move upwards with thin volume.

text.p: 0640 gmt - Turkish stocks up 1.4 pct in early trade on Wednesday. The market index was at 1,667 at 0805 GMT. Trade volume was 5.5 trillion lira.

*Brokers said speculations on the fate of the government dominate the market. Erden Gokay from Taksim Securities said: "Today's speculation is that the prevailing government will soon collapse, and a new one with new partners will be set up."

Daily Hurriyet quoted Ali Osman Sonmez, an MP from the coalition's junior partner True Path Party, saying that his party would end the alliance with the Welfare Party of Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan within two days. No confimation or denial was immediately available from the senior party officials.
* Analysts say the index is expected to face resistance at around 1,680 level.
